ads.adText: Our planet-friendly bottle is naturally better.

tells.explanation: Planet-friendly does not say what improved or offer evidence.

ads.verdictText: Planet-friendly does not say what improved or offer evidence.

ads.adText: Our leaf badge proves it: approved by the TideCup Green Team.

tells.phrase: approved by the TideCup Green Team
tells.explanation: The seller awarded its own badge. That is not independent verification.

ads.verdictText: The seller awarded its own badge. That is not independent verification.

ads.adText: Zero impact hydration. No lifecycle report needed.

tells.explanation: Zero impact is a sweeping promise without a defined scope or evidence.

ads.verdictText: Zero impact is a sweeping promise without a defined scope or evidence.

ads.adText: Now 30% less plastic. Lighter on the planet.

tells.explanation: Thirty percent less than which carton? A comparison needs a baseline.

ads.verdictText: Thirty percent less than which carton? A comparison needs a baseline.

ads.adText: This bottle body contains 80% recycled aluminium by mass. The case includes an independent materials audit verifying that amount. The cap is excluded.
ads.verdictText: The claim states an amount, the bottle-body scope, and verification. It does not cover the cap.

ads.adText: The new 500 ml carton uses 12 g of plastic instead of 15 g in our previous 500 ml carton. An independent packaging audit in this case verifies both measurements.
ads.verdictText: A same-size comparison, measured quantities, and verification support this packaging claim.

ads.adText: Certified Green by Our Own Awesome Team.

tells.explanation: An official-looking phrase means little when the certification is awarded by the seller.

ads.verdictText: An official-looking phrase means little when the certification is awarded by the seller.

ads.adText: All-natural care that is harmless to every river.

tells.explanation: Natural describes no measured environmental benefit. The river promise also has no supporting evidence.
Natural describes no measured environmental benefit. The river promise also has no supporting evidence.

ads.verdictText: Natural describes no measured environmental benefit. The river promise also has no supporting evidence.

ads.adText: Our box is recycled, so the whole lotion is sustainable.

tells.explanation: A recycled box does not establish the impact of the lotion or its ingredients.

ads.verdictText: A recycled box does not establish the impact of the lotion or its ingredients.

ads.adText: Twice as sustainable. No comparison needed.

tells.explanation: Twice as sustainable needs a measure and a named comparison.

ads.verdictText: Twice as sustainable needs a measure and a named comparison.

ads.adText: Our new empty 250 ml bottle weighs 20 g, compared with 25 g for the previous 250 ml bottle. An independent packaging audit in this case verifies the measurements.
ads.verdictText: The claim compares the same bottle size and includes measured, verified packaging weights.

ads.adText: The outer carton contains 70% recycled paper by mass, verified by an independent paper audit supplied in the case. The bottle and pump are outside this claim.
ads.verdictText: The carton claim has a measured amount, evidence, and a clear scope.

ads.adText: Eco-conscious style. Wear it and save the planet.

tells.explanation: The ad supplies neither a specific improvement nor evidence for its enormous promise.
The ad supplies neither a specific improvement nor evidence for its enormous promise.

ads.verdictText: The ad supplies neither a specific improvement nor evidence for its enormous promise.

ads.adText: Our jacket button is made from recycled plastic. That makes the entire jacket circular.

tells.explanation: One recycled button does not establish a circular system for the entire jacket.

ads.verdictText: One recycled button does not establish a circular system for the entire jacket.

ads.adText: Certified Earth Kind, awarded by PineThread itself.

tells.explanation: The brand gives itself the certification. Independent evidence is missing.

ads.verdictText: The brand gives itself the certification. Independent evidence is missing.

ads.adText: Our greenest shirt yet, with 40% less water.

tells.explanation: Water use is not comparable without a production boundary and a baseline.

ads.verdictText: Water use is not comparable without a production boundary and a baseline.

ads.adText: The shell fabric is 60% recycled polyester by mass. An independent fibre audit supplied in this case verifies the shell. Lining, zips, and buttons are excluded.
ads.verdictText: The amount and shell-only scope are specific, and an independent audit supports them.

ads.adText: This repair programme replaces damaged jacket zips for five years. The case supplies published terms and a completed repair record. No claim about total carbon impact is made.
ads.verdictText: A specific, documented repair service is supported. It makes no unsupported whole-product promise.

ads.adText: Naturally planet-positive snacks. Every bite cancels your footprint.

tells.explanation: The phrase defines no benefit, and the footprint claim needs much more evidence.
The phrase defines no benefit, and the footprint claim needs much more evidence.

ads.verdictText: The phrase defines no benefit, and the footprint claim needs much more evidence.

ads.adText: The shipping label is compostable, so our whole snack pack disappears safely in nature.

tells.phrase: our whole snack pack disappears safely in nature
tells.explanation: A shipping label does not establish how every part of the snack pack behaves.

ads.verdictText: A shipping label does not establish how every part of the snack pack behaves.

ads.adText: Our wrapper is 50% greener. Than what? That is our secret.

tells.explanation: Greener is not a defined measurement, and the comparison is deliberately hidden.

ads.verdictText: Greener is not a defined measurement, and the comparison is deliberately hidden.

ads.adText: Approved Sustainable by the OrchardPop Appreciation Club.

tells.explanation: A promotional club is not independent environmental verification.

ads.verdictText: A promotional club is not independent environmental verification.

ads.adText: The new 100 g snack carton weighs 18 g, compared with 24 g previously. An independent packaging audit supplied in the case confirms the weights. The snack recipe is unchanged.
ads.verdictText: The same product size, packaging weights, and independent record support the limited claim.

ads.adText: The delivery box contains 85% recycled paper by mass. An independent paper audit is supplied in this case. The inner food-safe pouch is not included.
ads.verdictText: The box claim is measured, verified, and clearly excludes the inner pouch.

ads.adText: The totally green charger. Unlimited use, zero environmental cost.

tells.explanation: The wording gives no defined benefit and ignores the evidence needed for a zero-impact promise.
The wording gives no defined benefit and ignores the evidence needed for a zero-impact promise.

ads.verdictText: The wording gives no defined benefit and ignores the evidence needed for a zero-impact promise.

ads.adText: Our cardboard insert is recycled. Therefore the entire device is sustainable.

tells.explanation: An insert tells you little about the device, its manufacture, or its electricity use.

ads.verdictText: An insert tells you little about the device, its manufacture, or its electricity use.

ads.adText: Uses 35% less energy than other chargers. We have not stated which ones.

tells.explanation: A fair energy comparison needs named devices and the same test conditions.

ads.verdictText: A fair energy comparison needs named devices and the same test conditions.

ads.adText: Certified Carbon Free by the LeafSignal Marketing Department.

tells.explanation: Marketing awarded its own badge. No independent carbon evidence is supplied.

ads.verdictText: Marketing awarded its own badge. No independent carbon evidence is supplied.

ads.adText: The battery can be replaced using two screws. The case supplies a repair manual, spare-part listing, and demonstration. This is a repairability claim, not a total-impact claim.
ads.verdictText: The specific battery-replacement claim has practical evidence and a limited scope.

ads.adText: Standby power is 0.2 W under the stated lab test, compared with 0.5 W for the previous model under the same test. An independent test report is supplied in the case.
ads.verdictText: Both models use the same test conditions, with measured power and independent evidence.
